title: ¿Dónde vas, Alfonso XII?
attribution: Anonymous Spanish ballad sung by children in Madrid after the death of Queen Mercedes in 1878, a reworking of a much older romance ("¿Dónde vas, el caballero?"); it has no known author and has been in oral tradition since the 19th century, so melody and words are public domain. Melody checked against the score on Wikimedia Commons.
